caption: The drawing depicts a bathroom with a variety of furnishings and intricate details. The floor is covered in black and white checkered tiles, with two green oval rugs. On the left side is a wooden bathtub with metal faucets and two white towels hanging on a rack nearby. Above the tub, there is a window with stained glass and a wooden frame. Next to the window hangs a lamp and a small curtained window with lace trim. In the center background is a large vanity with a marble countertop, twin faucets, various toiletry items, and a large mirror with an ornate gold frame reflecting a red robe. Above the mirror, a black chandelier with three pink glass shades hangs from the ceiling, which itself is decorated with gold filigree designs. Directly in front of the vanity is a wooden chair with a red cushion. On the right side, there is a toilet with an ornate base and a gold flush handle, next to a freestanding gold towel holder. In front of the toilet and slightly to the left is a decorative folding screen painted with images of colorful birds on branches. The walls are paneled in rich wood on the bottom half, while the upper half is covered in pale green wallpaper with a leafy vine pattern. Two more stained glass windows are visible, along with shelves holding various bottles and containers above a set of cabinetry.
title: Bathroom
